Comparison data

comparison_data.Rd

A list of data frames, each describing data that can be used in comparisons. See attr(*, "meta")$Source of each data frame for its source.

Usage

comparison_data

Format

An object of class list of length 13.

Examples

# Metadata for one of the data frames
print( attr(comparison_data[[1]], "meta") )
#>          About
#> 1 Stature (cm)
#>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Source
#> 1 Sperrin, M., Marshall, A. D., Higgins, V., Renehan, A. G., & Buchan, I. E. (2016). Body mass index relates weight to height differently in women and older adults: Serial cross-sectional surveys in England (1992-2011). Journal of Public Health, 38(3), 607-613. https://doi.org/10.1093/pubmed/fdv067
#>                       Notes
#> 1 Reported Cohen's d = 1.97

# Summary of all available data
ret = NULL
for (nn in names(comparison_data)) {
  r1 = data.frame(Label = nn
    , About = strtrim( attr(comparison_data[[nn]], "meta")$About, 25)
    , `Group 1` = comparison_data[[nn]]$group[1]
    , `Group 2` = comparison_data[[nn]]$group[2]
    , Source = strtrim( attr(comparison_data[[nn]], "meta")$Source, 25)
    , check.names = FALSE)
  ret = rbind(ret, r1)
}
print(ret)
